summary: PROENERGY is the existing ECP platform, so the census manager must be alias-matched rather than added again. ECP V closed a majority investment in August 2024, with Jeff Canon and management investing alongside it; exact percentages and the acquisition vehicle remain undisclosed. WattBridge, PROENERGY Services, AeroAdvantage, PowerFLX and individual plants remain subordinate. The later sale of all six historic ERCOT plants was an asset-level partial realization with service relationships retained, not a sale of PROENERGY, and ECP still marks the platform Current.
